items.text: Don't see the update yet? Restart Steam and it will download right away.
Thank you for all the reports since launch! This update is mostly about multiplayer for players on slow or long-distance connections, plus
a batch of fixes.

Much less lag after joining a game. When you joined, the host used to send the paint, rust and dirt of every vehicle and part all: at once. On slower connections this could push ping to extreme values. These are now sent at a pace your connection can handle, nearest: vehicles first.
New "Loading vehicle looks (x/y)" indicator next to the connection status while vehicle appearances are still downloading. It: only appears if loading takes more than a moment.
Less network traffic around loot. Painted or weathered parts that leave your view and come back no longer download their textures: again.
More stable connections on unreliable networks. Losing a single network packet no longer throws away a whole update.: Half-received data that never completes is now cleaned up.

Automatic port forwarding (UPnP / NAT-PMP). While you're in a lobby, the game asks your router to open UDP ports 7777–7780.: Friends can then connect to you directly instead of through a relay server, which usually means lower ping. If your router doesn't support: this, nothing changes. You can turn it off with the launch option -noupnp.
Fixed: after a dropped connection while hosting, every new attempt to host could fail until you restarted the game.
Fixed: if Steam briefly lost its connection, you could stay logged out of online services. The game now logs you back in as soon: as Steam reconnects.
Fixed: another player sitting on furniture far away from you (for example a chair found out in the world) didn't appear seated: when you walked up to them.
Fixed: items placed in a vehicle could appear metres behind their spot after loading a save made while driving.

Unstuck Vehicle can now put your vehicle back on the road. If you use Unstuck Vehicle when the vehicle isn't actually stuck,: you'll be asked whether to move it to the nearest road (within 300 m). Choose Yes and it's placed in a lane facing along the road, with you: standing right next to it. Not available while another player is sitting in or standing on the vehicle.

Fixed (multiplayer): after a vehicle had tipped over and been put back on its wheels, a non-host driver could get stuck. The: engine, steering and wheels worked, but the vehicle didn't move and other players saw its wheels spinning in place. Vehicles already: affected recover the next time the driver gets out and sits back in.

Fixed (multiplayer): grinding, polishing, sponge cleaning and spray painting by other players could land shifted or over a much: smaller area on the host's screen, even on a parked vehicle. The host's copy is what gets saved, so this also showed up after loading. Work: now lands in the same spot for everyone.

Fewer hitches on long drives. When driving fast, the game could hitch about every 2 km. Part of it came from the end pieces of: roadside barriers and guard rails, and they no longer cause it. We're also collecting timing data for this moment so we can track down any: remaining stalls.
Sharper textures with FSR 2 / DLSS. When an upscaler renders below your screen resolution, textures now keep their detail instead: of looking blurry.

Some players with very high polling rate gaming mice see the camera stutter or freeze when moving the mouse. A one-time notice on the: main menu now explains this and the workaround that helped many players: running the game as administrator (Steam and Windows steps: included). We're still working on a proper fix.
The limp mode warning (driving on a broken engine) and its tip are now translated into every language.
Fixed the missing name label when looking at the push point of the RVs and the School Bus.

Reports now include more connection details (ping, packet loss, relay use, how much vehicle data is still loading) and your country as: reported by Steam. This helps us fix lag between players who are far apart. Please keep pressing F8 when something goes wrong!

We built a test setup that simulates slow, long-distance connections (like many players in China and Russia have). Now we can reproduce: these multiplayer problems ourselves and check fixes before they ship.

releases.displayName: Patch Notes — Performance, Survival Balance & Quality of Life

items.text: TO RECEIVE THE UPDATE IMMEDIATELY, YOU MAY NEED TO RESTART STEAM. OTHERWISE, STEAM MAY DISTRIBUTE THE UPDATE WITH A DELAY.

Hello everyone! We’ve just pushed a big batch of fixes and improvements live! This update is packed with stability work, performance optimizations, vehicle and survival balancing, and a long requested controls feature all shaped by your fantastic feedback. Thank you for helping us make the game better!

notes.title: Here is the full list of what we fixed and improved

items.text: Multiplayer & Stability 📈
Kick Crash Fix: Fixed a crash that could take down the host when a player was kicked while driving a vehicle.
Disconnect Notice: You’ll now see a clear on-screen message in the main menu if you lose your connection to a session, instead of a silent drop.

Performance Optimization: Eliminated several sources of lag in multiplayer smarter loot streaming, lighter nameplate calculations when many players are nearby, and a major reduction of the hitches that occurred while new areas of the map generated.
Map & Environment Fixes 🗺️
Seamless Roads: Fixed visible gaps and width mismatches where roads connect between map tiles roads now join smoothly across the whole world.
Smoother World Generation: Reworked road and vegetation generation to remove the stutter spikes that happened as new points of interest loaded in.

Factory POI Adjustments: Fixed geometry issues in the Factory POI where players could get stuck. Starter House Colliders: Adjusted collision boundaries in the Starter House to prevent unexpected physics glitches.
POI Loot Positions: Corrected and rebalanced loot spawn locations at the Gas Station, Radio Station, and Watch Tower POIs. Surface Audio: Added proper surface footstep sounds to POI areas
Vehicles & Driving 🚐
Save-Load Slide Fix: Fixed vehicles sliding around frictionlessly after loading a save (caused by leftover invisible wheel colliders).

Driving Controls HUD: Added an on-screen driving-actions panel. The ignition now tells you exactly why the engine won’t start (missing/broken engine, dead battery, or no fuel), and warns you if the handbrake is engaged.

Engine Heat Rebalance: Overheating now works as intended — reworked the engine heat/cooling model so the engine actually reaches its overheat point under real conditions, with retuned radiator cooling.

Fuel & Battery Balance: Rebalanced fuel consumption and battery drain rates for a fairer driving experience. Ride Along: You can now stand on a moving vehicle and ride along with it without sliding off.
Gameplay, Balancing & Bug Fixes 🔧

Rescue Feature Upgrade: Greatly expanded the player “unstuck” rescue radius, making it much easier to safely free yourself if you glitch into the environment — and removed a stutter that occurred near parked vehicles.
Jump Fix: Fixed getting locked into a jump state (stuck + slowed) and the jump animation playing without an actual jump when the jump key was spammed.

Survival Rebalance: Retuned how hunger, thirst, and energy deplete over the day. Survival stats no longer freeze after being revived, and you’ll now get on-screen warning effects (vignette, heartbeat, desaturation) when your overall condition gets critical from starvation, dehydration, or poison. Cooling
Fix: Refrigerated food now correctly stops spoiling — including in multiplayer and after loading a save.
Farming Save Fix: Fixed harvested fruit disappearing from plant pots and pots getting permanently stuck after loading a save.
Buried Treasure Fix: Fixed buried chests (and their lids/locks) being interactable before they were fully dug up.
Food & Cooking Balance: Rebalanced food freshness, spoilage, and cooking times across produce, drinks, and cooked dishes.
Coffee Machine Fix: Fixed the coffee pot not snapping correctly onto the coffee machine. Varied Start
Time: New games now begin at a different time of day each session.
Controls, UI & Quality of Life 🎮
Rebindable Controls: You can now remap your keybindings in Settings, organized into categories (on-foot, driving, etc.), with conflict detection so you don’t accidentally double-bind a key.
Auto Graphics Quality: On first launch the game now detects your hardware and picks a sensible default graphics quality level.
Lobby Browser: The lobby browser is now region-aware, with an “All Regions” toggle and ping info to help you find the best games to join.
Version Label: Added the current game version number to the in-game HUD.
Naming & Translations: Cleaned up item and vehicle names and updated translations across all supported languages.
More improvements are on the way! 🛠️

items.text: TO RECEIVE THE UPDATE IMMEDIATELY, YOU MAY NEED TO RESTART STEAM. OTHERWISE, STEAM MAY DISTRIBUTE THE UPDATE WITH A DELAY.

Hello everyone! We’ve just pushed another hotfix live! This update continues our focus on crushing bugs, improving your overall experience, and fine-tuning gameplay mechanics based on your fantastic feedback. Thank you for helping us make the game better!
Late-Joiner Ignition Fix: Resolved a bug that prevented players who join a session in progress from using the vehicle ignition.
Vehicle State Sync: Fixed an issue where a late-joining player could unintentionally stop a vehicle that was already running.
Performance Optimization: Addressed and eliminated several instances of unwanted lag to provide a smoother multiplayer experience.
Factory POI Adjustments: Fixed specific geometry issues in the Factory POI, particularly the gaps between pipes where players were getting stuck.
Starter House Colliders: Adjusted and fixed the collision boundaries (colliders) in the Starter House to prevent unexpected physics glitches.
Bus Stop Loot Positions: Corrected and adjusted the spawn locations of loot items at the Bus Stop POI.
Rescue Feature Upgrade: Expanded the effective radius of the player "unstuck" area, making it much easier to safely free yourself if you glitch into the environment.
More improvements are on the way! 🛠️

releases.displayName: Hotfix Deployed! Major FPS rate update! Addressing Your Feedback & Fixing Bugs

items.text: 📢Hello everyone!
We’ve just pushed a new hotfix live! This update focuses heavily on resolving the bugs you've reported to make your gameplay experience much more stable. Thank you for your continued feedback!

notes.title: Here is the full list of what we fixed today

items.text: Performance & Stability📈
Major FPS Optimizations: Implemented significant frame rate improvements. You should now experience much smoother gameplay without low FPS rate, even if you are hosting the session!
Gameplay & Bug Fixes🔧
Fixed a bug that caused players to spawn underground.
Resolved various glitches and issues related to dead players.
Corrected visual and functional bugs within the Main Menu UI.
Rebalanced engine fuel and fluid consumption rates.
Improved loot spawning logic for better item distribution.
Refined damage registration to ensure players receive damage accurately.
More improvements are on the way!🛠️
